title: Phaladeepika
author: Mantreswara
known_defects: Chapter 8, printed p.96: the section heading 'JUPITER' is run onto the end of Mercury's 12th-house paragraph. Corpus preserved as printed; card PD.08.Mercury.12 tightens its span and records why.

Chapter 8, verses 34-35: the Notes worked example and verse 35 appear to disagree about whether proximity to the Bhava-Madhya increases or decreases a placement's effect. Not yet extracted; needs adjudication.

Chapter 8, printed p.99-101: a transcribed horoscope chart and an editorial aside about Swami Ramakrishna Paramahamsa sit inside the Saturn section. Both are tier-3 apparatus and are excluded from rule extraction.
Chapter 9, printed p.108-109: two transcribed horoscope charts and a worked example ending in an aside about Abraham Lincoln. Tier-3 apparatus, excluded from rule extraction.

Chapter 9, verse 14 vs its Notes: Mantreswara says an exalted planet makes the native a ruler of the Earth; the translator's Notes say plainly that it does not. Both are encoded, as PD.09.Dignity.Exalted (tier 1) and PD.09.Dignity.Exalted.Notes (tier 2), and the disagreement is preserved rather than resolved.

Chapter 9, verses 13-20: universally quantified over the grahas ('a planet', not a named one) or over other rules. The condition language has no variables, so these eleven cards are recorded and marked inert. The knowledge is encoded and verified; it does not yet fire.
